ImageDescription.value: From left: Agriculture Deputy Secretary Dr. Kathleen Merrigan, Steve Murray, Murray Family Farms, Bakersfield, CA., Phil Petrilli, Regional Director, Chipotle Mexican Grill and Marc Zammit, Vice President, Sustainability and Culinary Initiatives, Compass Group listen to Jim Slama, President and Founder, FamilyFarmed.org’s On-Farm Food Safety Project presentation during a brief overview of the online risk management tool www.onfarmfoodsafety.org. Deputy Secretary Merrigan, Murray, Petrilli, Zammit and leaders from agriculture and food organizations announced the release of the online tool at the United States Department of Agriculture in Washington, D.C., on Thursday, December 15, 2011. The On-Farm Food Safety Project is the first of its kind and was developed by a broad coalition of farm and produce industry partners with lead funding from the USDA Risk Management Agency.
